# Button

A text button for digital surfaces — an intentional addition, since the guidelines define colour pairings but no button.

`Gradnext.Button` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<Gradnext.Button>…</Gradnext.Button>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Gradnext.Button">…</x-import>
```

## Props (ButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "ghost"` | primary = Chrome Yellow, secondary = Periwinkle, ghost = outlined ink. Default "primary". |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |

_Also accepts: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>._
